news.title: Researchers: Parents should combine words with gestures to help their children learn
news.summary_en: University of Iowa neuroscientists find in a new study that the brain waves of parents and their child are synced when the parent combines speech with gestures during instruction. The findings could help improve a child’s ability to learn and develop.

news.title: Iowa’s 2026 incoming class, by the numbers
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa’s 2026 incoming class marks the fifth consecutive first-year class of more than 5,000 students and again is among the largest in university history. It’s also one of the highest achieving, with an average high school grade-point average of 3.87. Read more about our newest Hawkeyes.

news.title: UI Health Care shifting focus to more quickly expand access to care for Iowans
news.summary_en: UI Health Care is revising its facilities strategy to more quickly expand access to care for Iowans. By modernizing and expanding existing spaces instead of building a new hospital tower, the health system expects to add about 100 patient beds and serve an estimated 23,000 patients sooner.

news.title: UI professor named a 2026 Mellon Emerging Faculty Leader
news.summary_en: Ashley Howard, University of Iowa assistant professor of history, has been named a 2026 Mellon Emerging Faculty Leader. The recognition comes from the Andrew W. Mellon Foundation, the nation’s leading funder of the arts, culture, and humanities.

news.title: UI outlines strategy for artificial intelligence
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa is building a campuswide strategy for artificial intelligence to coordinate and strengthen efforts across teaching, research, and public engagement. This approach will focus on three core components that connect the entire campus: engaging across disciplines, ensuring responsible expertise, and amplifying human potential.

news.title: UI College of Dentistry seeks to expand lab space, make room for research growth
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa is seeking permission from the Iowa Board of Regents to proceed with planning renovation and expansion of research laboratory space in the Dental Science Building in the College of Dentistry, where external research funding nearly doubled in the past five years.

news.title: UI to raze Halsey Hall, seek approval to begin planning IMU parking ramp expansion
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa is seeking permission from the Iowa Board of Regents to begin planning a modernization and expansion of the Iowa Memorial Union Parking Ramp, making it easier and safer for people to drive and walk in a busy area of campus.

news.title: Campus can submit proposals for FY 2028 P3 funding
news.summary_en: Proposals are now being accepted for fiscal year 2028 P3 projects that support the University of Iowa’s 2022-2027 Strategic Plan. Preliminary proposals must be submitted by Nov. 13.

news.title: New 9/11 documentary highlights Iowa alumna’s role in rebuilding ground zero
news.summary_en: A new documentary, 9/11: Reclaiming Ground Zero, tells how UI alumna Carolyn Lukensmeyer and AmericaSpeaks brought 5,000 New Yorkers together to help shape the rebuilding of ground zero. The film, executive produced by Lukensmeyer, emphasizes citizen engagement — something she says she learned the importance of during her time at Iowa.
